adjudication.rationale:
In the new webhook handler (apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts), the secret check is only an equality comparison:

req.headers[process.env.CALCOM_WEBHOOK_HEADER_NAME || "calcom-webhook-secret"] !== process.env.CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET

There is no guard that CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET must be set/non-empty. If CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET is configured as an empty string (which the updated .env.example suggests as the default: CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET=""), a request can satisfy the check by sending the header with an empty value ("calcom-webhook-secret: "), because "" === "". That effectively removes authentication for this endpoint under a common misconfiguration, and there is no explicit validation/logging to prevent or highlight it.
